title: Beneficiary enrolment, trust and validation controls
workflow: Capture recipient details and permitted account identifiers
Normalize and validate syntax against target rail/profile
Perform authorized ownership/name verification where supported
Apply risk screening and step-up before high-risk activation
Store versioned beneficiary status with edit, pause and revoke actions
Revalidate status immediately before each payment
invariants: Successful syntax validation is not evidence of beneficiary ownership
No unverified recipient auto-activation where institution policy requires checks
Editing account reference revokes prior approval and confirmation
Do not expose full recipient account data in unrelated logs
Cross-customer beneficiary IDs cannot be reused without authorization
A blocked recipient cannot receive a new authorized instruction
Proof of identity and payment finality remain separate controls
acceptance_tests: Update recipient reference invalidates saved challenge
Unverified name check cannot be shown as verified
independent_gate: Institution payments scheme rules, authorized validation sources, risk approval and secure API tests.
